job_description:
Role: OSAT Supplier and Operations Manager
Company: GlobalFoundries
Rubric version: demo-v2
Requirements:
1. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in semiconductor operations, outsourced manufacturing, OSAT management, sourcing or commodity management, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation, or continuous improvement.
2. Support supplier negotiations, pricing analysis, and commercial contract implementation.

SUPPLIER OPERATIONS MANAGER
Zenith Components | 2017–2026
Nine years in supplier operations and sourcing.
Compared quotations from four outsourced assembly suppliers; negotiated a three-year supply agreement with two component manufacturers; built price tiers and an annual cost-reduction plan; drafted commercial schedules; coordinated signature, purchase-order setup, and contract implementation.
Led monthly supplier reviews covering cost, delivery, quality, and capacity.
